meta.name: content-engine
meta.description: Create platform-native content systems for X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, newsletters, and repurposed multi-platform campaigns. Use when the user wants social posts, threads, scripts, content calendars, or one source asset adapted cleanly across platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为多平台生成适配原生风格的内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为不同平台快速创作和适配内容
copy.tagline_en: Create platform-native content for social media and newsletters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create and adapt content for different platforms

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的原始素材（文章、笔记、演示等），为不同平台（X、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、Newsletter）生成适配的内容草稿，并确保每篇内容有真实主张，避免套话和虚假互动。
howto.when: 当你要求写社交媒体帖子、脚本、内容日历，或需要将一篇文章、播客等素材改编到多个平台时触发。

say.text: 帮我根据这篇博客写一条X帖子和一条LinkedIn帖子。
say.note: Claude会提取核心观点并分别适配平台格式。

say.text: 把这段播客转录改写成TikTok脚本和Newsletter。
say.note: Claude会提取原子主张，按平台规则改写。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates platform-native drafts (X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Newsletter) from your source material (articles, notes, demos, etc.), ensuring each piece has a real claim and avoids generic hype or engagement bait.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for social posts, threads, scripts, content calendars, or repurposing a single asset across multiple platforms.

say_en.text: Turn this blog post into an X post and a LinkedIn post.
say_en.note: Claude extracts core claims and adapts format per platform.

say_en.text: Rewrite this podcast transcript into a TikTok script and a newsletter.
say_en.note: Claude extracts atomic claims and restructures for each platform.
